verdict.rationale: Gusto is a payroll, HR, and business-finance platform that is expanding into banking, so AI-assisted procurement intake is a fair question for it. However, the evidence pack shows no procurement request forms and no AI parsing of vendor contracts. The banking, money-dashboard, MCP, and CLI items concern other capabilities and do not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have vendor contracts parsed by AI to auto-populate procurement request forms
